card.line: Gabbatha, also called the Stone Pavement, was the place outside Pilate's judgment hall where he sat in judgment and handed Jesus over to be crucified.

moments.title: Pilate sits in judgment
moments.text: Pilate brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha. He said to the Jews, "Here is your King!"

moments.title: Jesus handed over to be crucified
moments.text: The chief priests said, "We have no king but Caesar." Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
